scope: r940 temelinde AI sağlayıcı seçenekleri, anahtar gereksinimi ve hata sonrası yapılandırma akışı. Sistem sağlığı erişim yolu açıklanır.
changes: Altı sağlayıcı: OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini, Kimi/Moonshot, Anthropic ve elle seçilen NVIDIA geliştirici denemesi.
Araçlar menüsünde AI bağlantıları; sağlayıcı/model seçimi, eksik veya reddedilen anahtar için giriş ekranı, oturumluk veya isteğe bağlı cihazda saklama.
NVIDIA CORS kısıtı için kurulabilir kullanıcıya ait Worker şablonu integration klasöründe; henüz yayımlanmış bir servis değildir.
İstek gövdesi dahil zaman sınırı, toplam 40 saniye / 8 deneme tavanı, iptal, tek etkin AI isteği, kota bekleme süresine uyma.
Sistem sağlığı raporunda anahtarsız AI hata kodu, sağlayıcı, model ve süre; önceki oturumdan olay geçmişi korunur.
Mevcut görseller, sesler, sayaç çekirdeği ve kullanıcı kayıtları korunur.

release-results.json.testEnvironment: Node VM; real service-worker source, in-memory cache/network; no browser lifecycle emulation claim
limitations: Real browser install/update lifecycle and IndexedDB persistence were not tested by this harness.
Physical Android lock-screen audio, memory pressure and process termination were not tested.

ai.kind: Node VM regression against r941 router with deterministic HTTP mocks; not live-provider or browser verification

results.name: six supported provider presets preserve router consumer API
missing keys produce actionable MISSING_KEY and zero network requests
keys remain session-only without opt-in and are cleared by empty value
credential persistence is explicit and disabling persistence clears saved secret
401 authentication failure falls back to a configured provider without exposing raw error text
rejected key is not retried until explicitly replaced
explicit preferred provider prevents silent cross-provider request
429 Retry-After cooldown prevents immediate repeat requests
404 model error retries next model of same provider
response-body stall is bounded by full request timeout
external cancellation aborts in-flight HTTP without fallback or provider health failure
already-aborted signal produces no network request
parallel completion is rejected with AI_BUSY and cancellation releases single-flight lock
empty successful response is classified INVALID_RESPONSE without raw provider content
API keys use headers and never appear in request URLs
NVIDIA without configured proxy fails locally with PROXY_REQUIRED
global deadline bounds multiple stalled providers to forty seconds
automatic fallback never sends a developer-only NVIDIA request
NVIDIA proxy accepts only its restricted HTTPS path and rejects credential/query/foreign-host URLs
network attempt cap bounds a full model-not-found cascade
manual connection test respects quota cooldown rather than hammering API
oversized declared response body is rejected before parsing
missing-key prompt opens a labelled native dialog and preserves the same password inputs across close/reopen
settings tool mounts once and opens existing AI settings without any API request
Kimi K2.6 uses Moonshot endpoint with disabled thinking and omits incompatible temperature
Kimi K3 uses low reasoning with 4096 output budget and no disabled-thinking or temperature conflict
Gemini uses API key header and generation protocol while excluding thought parts from final answer
Anthropic uses versioned browser-access headers and text content blocks
allowed preflight is exact and needs no key
other or missing origins have no CORS grant
wildcard origin config rejected; explicit other HTTPS origin supported
unsupported preflight headers or method rejected
GET, other path and query rejected without upstream traffic
missing key and non-JSON content rejected
fixed target, non-streaming bounded payload, no cookie forwarding
Kimi preset has compatible fixed parameters
unknown models, invalid tokens and multimodal/messages rejected
request body bounded by both declared and streamed size
response strips metadata reasoning and keys; no caching
auth and quota errors sanitized; numeric Retry-After exposed
Retry-After handles HTTP date, excessive delay and malformed value
redirect is never followed and upstream errors leak no details
upstream response size bounded including chunked bodies
HTML, invalid JSON, empty or reasoning-only output rejected
15 second deadline covers waiting for headers even if fetch ignores abort
same deadline covers a stalled upstream response body and cancels it
request body itself cannot stall indefinitely
caller abort cancels upstream and returns no raw error

bounded record and incident flood
hidden tempo identifies source
visibility stops timer, return cannot become false stall
genuine foreground progress absence gets uncertain warning
read-only run leaves count untouched and zero device voices not appfail
previous unclean classified possible with pinpoint metadata preserved
malformed previous arrays do not break boot
deep integrity match
deep integrity mismatch
deep integrity malformed
real lock transport event keeps partial evidence without fabricated playing
quality decode failure retains code and bytes only
repeated issue latest evidence uses latest context
sequential cheap runs release promise lock

limitations: Gerçek sağlayıcı API anahtarıyla canlı üretim isteği, sağlayıcı kotası ve tarayıcı CORS davranışı bu paketin otomatik testlerinde doğrulanmış sayılmaz.
Ücretsiz kullanım sağlayıcının güncel kota, deneme kredisi ve hesap koşullarına bağlıdır; açık kaynak model ücretsiz barındırılan API anlamına gelmez.
VM testleri gerçek kaynak kodunu yalıtılmış ağ/önbellek taklitleriyle denetler; gerçek tarayıcı kurulumu veya fiziksel Android kilit ekranı, ses, bellek baskısı ve kapanma testi değildir.
Canlı siteye dağıtım yapılmadı. Paket, mevcut kuruluma birleştirilecek toplu güncellemedir.
